components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when supplied it is combined with
            the last name to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is
            ignored on input. On read it is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on
            create. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either
            form: a non-blank 'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create and, when present, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's ageBand relative to the registration date. Formatted as an ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the create is allowed
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address;
            otherwise such a duplicate is rejected. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted as '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city) and
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last name. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the owner's
                customer code. Derived on read from the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year's start year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to the
                fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                business-day-adjusted registration date.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year the registrationDate falls in
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived on read from the owner's customer
                code and registration date.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the customer code, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on create when the owner joins
                an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' flag; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A2B7C1D0E
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
                owner's normalized telephone, email and household id joined with '|' as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>', with a missing email or household id
                contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates (rejected on create)
                only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2B7C1D0E'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. Derived on read from the
                owner's telephone, which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read from the owner's title and last
                name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title was supplied, or just the last
                name when it was not.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners already stored when this owner was created that
                share its first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's registration day was already busy when this owner was
                created: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on that day,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, when created, softly matched an already-stored owner:
                one that shares its lastName and postcode but has a different telephone.
                Assigned on create; when true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' identifies the matched
                owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the already-stored owner this owner softly matched on create (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields

      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when supplied it is combined with
            the last name to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is
            ignored on input. On read it is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on
            create. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either
            form: a non-blank 'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create and, when present, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's ageBand relative to the registration date. Formatted as an ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the create is allowed
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address;
            otherwise such a duplicate is rejected. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted as '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city) and
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last name. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the owner's
                customer code. Derived on read from the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year's start year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to the
                fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                business-day-adjusted registration date.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year the registrationDate falls in
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived on read from the owner's customer
                code and registration date.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the customer code, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on create when the owner joins
                an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' flag; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A2B7C1D0E
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
                lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of the owner's normalized telephone, lower-cased
                email and the Soundex code of its last name joined with '|' as
                'sha256(<telephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>)', with a missing telephone
                or email contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates (rejected on
                create) only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3b8f2e1a9c7d4b6e0f5a2c8d1e4b7a0c3f6e9d2b5a8c1f4e7d0a3b6c9e2f5a8b'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. Derived on read from the
                owner's telephone, which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read from the owner's title and last
                name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title was supplied, or just the last
                name when it was not.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-

                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

                share its first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-

                otherwise false.

              example: false
              readOnly: true

              type: boolean
              example: false

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional; when supplied it is combined with
            the last name to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this value is
            ignored on input. On read it is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized on
            create. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either
            form: a non-blank 'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create and, when present, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's ageBand relative to the registration date. Formatted as an ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the create is allowed
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address;
            otherwise such a duplicate is rejected. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted as '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived on read from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted as '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city) and
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last name. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the owner's
                customer code. Derived on read from the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's registrationDate falls in, formatted as 'FY<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year's start year. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to the
                fiscal year that starts that calendar year. Derived on read from the
                business-day-adjusted registration date.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year the registrationDate falls in
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived on read from the owner's customer
                code and registration date.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Points start at 0 and add
                2 when the owner has an email address, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more
                than 1 fiscal year. A newly created owner has no tenure yet, so tenure points are
                not earned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create by banding the
                owner's membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the customer code, i.e. the
                region derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to its city via a
                fixed city-to-region table), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived on read from the owner's locality
                via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no timezone in the table.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of their registrationDate, derived on read from the
                owner's birthDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID

## Summary of changes

**Identity key redesign** — `identityKey` is now `SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName))`:

- **New `Soundex.java`** (`model` package) — a standard American Soundex encoder (`encode(name)` → 4-char code), a small single-responsibility helper alongside the existing `Luhn`/`Sha256Hex`.
- **`Sha256Hex.java`** — added `hex(value)` returning the full 64-char **lower-case** digest (the existing `prefix(...)` upper-case helper, still used for `householdId`, is untouched).
- **`Owner.getIdentityKey()`** — now composes `telephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName)` and hashes it via `Sha256Hex.hex(...)`, yielding the 64-hex key the tests assert.
